about: A genuine requirement that the physician provide malpractice coverage: 'You are required to provide malpractice coverage of $1,000,000/$3,000,000 before your start date of 11/2'. Insurance is not care, so the sentence still asks. Synthetic.
subject: Coverage for the Birchmont assignment
body:
Hello Dr. Testa,

Thank you for accepting the assignment at Birchmont Example Medical Center. This group does not supply malpractice insurance to locum physicians. You are required to provide malpractice coverage of $1,000,000/$3,000,000 before your start date of 11/2.

Best,
Reese Calloway
Medical Staff Services
Birchmont Example Medical Center
Phone: 802.555.0149
